completion_data.completion_summary: Retired the superseded soundness machinery under FormalSystem/Metalogic/SoundnessLemmas/: deleted DenseValidity.lean and Core.lean outright, removed the 420-line duplicate axiom_swap_valid dispatcher and the 298-line private axiom_locally_valid with the helpers they alone consumed, transplanted the eight survivors into FrameClassVariants.lean, and retired the local IsValid notion in favour of ValidIn/ValidDiscrete. The surviving 45-arm dispatcher axiom_swap_valid_general now delegates one line per arm to 29 newly extracted, docstring-carrying per-constructor lemmas. The directory went from 2,487 lines across five files to 1,457 across three; lake build is green, check-module-invariants.sh reports ALL CHECKS PASSED, and the C2/C14 axiom baselines are unchanged.

line_ceiling_1400.note: 57 lines over the ~1,400 ceiling; whole gap is the anticipated line-additivity of arm extraction (29 lemmas cost ~+228 lines of signature and docstring against ~+90 budgeted). Reported rather than trimmed, per the plan's Phase 9 instruction.
